An unavailable/helper failure after an exact verified down does not itself select preserve-session; healthy continuous witness permits the protected restore-hid release. Foreign, partial, ended, stale or unverified ownership preserves session modifiers and remains failed.

Swift preserves raw HID|session bits, subtracting only the attributed Shift bit under the verified release mode and no other modifier. Both global key/flag tables may contain synthetic state and are not independently trusted physical-ownership evidence.
Receipt raw flags must exactly match witnessed up; final both-source modifier masks and all four Shift states must be clean before pending is cleared.
SIGINT/SIGTERM runner finalization calls guard.finalize before owned supervisor/child shutdown.
